tax_year.rationale: Tax year is a header-level attribute not represented as a discrete leaf element in the candidate list; no matching canonical element exists.

fiscal_year_begin.rationale: Fiscal year begin date is a header field not present as a leaf element in the candidate list.

fiscal_year_end.rationale: Fiscal year end date is a header field not present as a leaf element in the candidate list.

entity_name.rationale: The estate or trust name is a header element not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

employer_identification_number.rationale: TrustEIN is the closest canonical element for the EIN of the estate or trust; estates would use an analogous field not separately listed, so this is the best available match.

fiduciary_name.rationale: Fiduciary name is a header element not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

fiduciary_title.rationale: Fiduciary title is a header element not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

fiduciary_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street/city/state/zip into one string; canonical schema splits into multiple address sub-elements not present in this candidate list — blueprint should split into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, and ZIPCd fields.

date_entity_created.rationale: EstateOrTrustCreateDt directly maps to the date the estate or trust was created, as entered in the header block.

entity_type.rationale: Entity type is a category captured by multiple indicator checkboxes (DecedentsEstateInd, SimpleTrustInd, ComplexTrustInd, etc.) rather than a single canonical element; the blueprint should be refactored into separate boolean fields per entity type.

initial_return.rationale: InitialReturnInd directly corresponds to the 'Initial return' checkbox on Form 1041.

final_return.rationale: FutureFilingNotRequiredInd corresponds to the 'Final return' checkbox indicating no future filing is required.

amended_return.rationale: AmendedReturnInd directly corresponds to the 'Amended return' checkbox on Form 1041.

change_in_fiduciary.rationale: FiduciaryChangeInd directly corresponds to the checkbox indicating a change in fiduciary during the tax year.

name_change.rationale: TrustNameChangeInd corresponds to the name change checkbox; FiduciaryNameChangeInd (idx 52) refers to fiduciary name change, so TrustNameChangeInd is the correct entity-level match.

address_change.rationale: FiduciaryAddressChangeInd directly corresponds to the address change checkbox on Form 1041.

number_of_k1s.rationale: ScheduleK1AttachedCnt directly represents the count of Schedule K-1s attached to the return.

interest_income.rationale: TaxableInterestAmt corresponds to taxable interest income reported on Line 1 of Part I.

ordinary_dividends.rationale: OrdinaryDividendsAmt corresponds to ordinary dividends reported on Line 2a of Part I.

qualified_dividends.rationale: QlfyDividendsEstateTrustAmt corresponds to qualified dividends reported on Line 2b of Part I.

business_income_loss.rationale: NetProfitOrLossAmt corresponds to net business income or loss from Schedule C reported on Line 3 of Part I.

capital_gain_loss.rationale: CapitalGainLossAmt corresponds to net capital gain or loss from Schedule D reported on Line 4 of Part I.

rents_royalties_partnerships.rationale: NetRentalIncomeOrLossAmt corresponds to income or loss from rents, royalties, partnerships, etc. reported on Line 5 of Part I.

farm_income_loss.rationale: NetFarmProfitLossAmt corresponds to net farm income or loss from Schedule F reported on Line 6 of Part I.

ordinary_gain_loss.rationale: TotalOrdinaryGainLossAmt corresponds to ordinary gain or loss from Form 4797 reported on Line 7 of Part I.

other_income.rationale: TotalOtherIncomeAmt corresponds to other income reported on Line 8 of Part I.

total_income.rationale: TotalIncomeAmt corresponds to total income on Line 9 of Part I, the sum of lines 1 through 8.

interest_expense.rationale: InterestAmt corresponds to interest expense deducted on Line 10 of Part II.

taxes.rationale: TaxesAmt corresponds to taxes deducted on Line 11 of Part II.

fiduciary_fees.rationale: FiduciaryFeesAmt directly corresponds to fiduciary fees deducted on Line 12 of Part II.

charitable_deduction.rationale: CharitableDeductionsAmt corresponds to the charitable deduction from Schedule A reported on Line 13 of Part II.

attorney_accountant_fees.rationale: TaxPreparationFeesAmt corresponds to attorney, accountant, and return preparer fees deducted on Line 14 of Part II.

other_deductions.rationale: OtherDeductionsAmt corresponds to other deductions not subject to the 2% floor reported on Line 15a of Part II.

allowable_miscellaneous_deductions.rationale: No candidate element specifically represents allowable miscellaneous itemized deductions subject to the 2% floor (Line 15b); no matching canonical element found.

total_deductions.rationale: TotalDeductionAmt corresponds to total deductions reported on Line 16 of Part II.

adjusted_total_income.rationale: AdjustedTotalIncomeAmt corresponds to adjusted total income or loss reported on Line 17 of Part II.

income_distribution_deduction.rationale: IncomeDistributionDeductionAmt corresponds to the income distribution deduction from Schedule B reported on Line 18 of Part II.

estate_tax_deduction.rationale: EstateTaxDeductionAmt corresponds to the estate tax deduction reported on Line 19 of Part II.

exemption.rationale: ExemptionAmt corresponds to the exemption amount reported on Line 20 of Part II.

taxable_income.rationale: TaxableIncomeAmt corresponds to taxable income reported on Line 21 of Part II.

schedule_g_tax_on_taxable_income.rationale: TaxAmt corresponds to tax computed on taxable income reported on Line 1a of Schedule G.

alternative_minimum_tax.rationale: AlternativeMinimumTaxAmt corresponds to the alternative minimum tax from Schedule I reported on Line 1b of Schedule G.

net_investment_income_tax.rationale: EstTrustNetInvstIncomeTaxAmt corresponds to the Net Investment Income Tax from Form 8960 reported in Schedule G.

household_employment_taxes.rationale: HouseholdEmploymentTaxAmt corresponds to household employment taxes from Schedule H reported in Schedule G.

other_taxes_schedule_g.rationale: OtherTaxDueAmt corresponds to other taxes in Schedule G including recapture taxes and lump-sum distribution taxes.

total_credits.rationale: TotalCreditsAmt corresponds to total credits claimed in Schedule G against the gross tax.

total_tax.rationale: TotalTaxAmt corresponds to total tax from Schedule G after all credits and additions.

payments_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt corresponds to federal income tax withheld at source on the withholding payments line.

estimated_tax_payments.rationale: EstimatedTaxPaymentsAmt corresponds to estimated tax payments made during the year.

tax_paid_with_extension.rationale: ExtsnRequestIncomeTaxPaidAmt corresponds to tax paid with Form 7004 (extension request).

other_payments_credits.rationale: OtherCreditsPaymentsAmt corresponds to other payments and refundable credits not listed separately.

total_payments.rationale: TotalPaymentsAmt corresponds to the total of all payments and credits applied against the tax liability.

estimated_tax_penalty.rationale: EstimatedPenaltyAmt corresponds to the estimated tax underpayment penalty line.

tax_due.rationale: TaxDueAmt at the root xpath (idx 120) corresponds to the balance of tax owed shown on the 'Tax due' line, distinct from idx 46 which is nested under F1041TotalTaxGrp.

overpayment.rationale: OverpaymentAmt corresponds to the overpayment amount when total payments exceed total tax liability.

overpayment_credited_to_next_year.rationale: AppliedToEsTaxAmt corresponds to the portion of overpayment credited to the following year's estimated tax.

overpayment_refunded.rationale: RefundAmt corresponds to the portion of overpayment to be refunded to the estate or trust.

schedule_b_accounting_income.rationale: AccountingIncomeAmt corresponds to accounting income entered on Line 1 of Schedule B.

schedule_b_distributable_net_income.rationale: DistributableNetIncomeAmt corresponds to distributable net income (DNI) computed on Schedule B.

schedule_b_income_required_to_distribute.rationale: FirstTierDistributionAmt corresponds to income required to be distributed currently (first-tier distributions) on Line 9 of Schedule B.

schedule_b_other_amounts_paid.rationale: SecondTierDistributionAmt corresponds to other amounts paid or credited (second-tier distributions) on Line 10 of Schedule B.

schedule_b_total_distributions.rationale: TotalDistributionAmt corresponds to total distributions on Line 11 of Schedule B.

schedule_b_tax_exempt_income_allocated.rationale: TaxExemptIncomeAmt corresponds to tax-exempt income included in distributions on Line 12 of Schedule B.

schedule_b_tentative_income_distribution.rationale: TentativeIncmDistriDedAmt corresponds to the tentative income distribution deduction on Line 13 of Schedule B.

schedule_b_income_distribution_deduction.rationale: SchBAdjustedTotalIncomeAmt best represents the final Schedule B income distribution deduction figure that flows to Part II Line 18.

section_645_election.rationale: Section645ElectionInd directly corresponds to the Section 645 election indicator.

foreign_account.rationale: ForeignAccountsQuestionInd corresponds to the foreign account question in the Other Information section.

foreign_trust.rationale: ForeignTrustInd corresponds to the foreign trust question in the Other Information section.

form_1041_t_filed.rationale: No candidate element represents whether Form 1041-T was filed to allocate estimated tax payments to beneficiaries; no matching canonical element found.

third_party_designee.rationale: No candidate element represents the third-party designee Yes/No checkbox; no matching canonical element found.

third_party_designee_name.rationale: No candidate element represents the third-party designee name; no matching canonical element found.

third_party_designee_phone.rationale: No candidate element represents the third-party designee phone number; no matching canonical element found.

third_party_pin.rationale: No candidate element represents the third-party designee PIN; no matching canonical element found.

preparer_name.rationale: Paid preparer name is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

preparer_ptin.rationale: Preparer PTIN is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

preparer_self_employed.rationale: Preparer self-employed checkbox is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

preparer_firm_name.rationale: Preparer firm name is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

preparer_firm_ein.rationale: Preparer firm EIN is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

preparer_firm_address.rationale: Preparer firm address is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

preparer_phone.rationale: Preparer phone is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

preparer_date.rationale: Preparer signature date is not present among the candidate leaf elements provided.

beneficiaries.rationale: Blueprint bundles beneficiary K-1 data into an array; canonical schema represents this through separate Schedule K-1 forms not exposed as leaf elements in this Form 1041 candidate list — blueprint should reference the attached K-1 schema separately.
